responsibility: Texinfo internals manual for GNU Modula-2 that documents the front end’s architecture, passes, GCC integration model, runtime interactions, and language-specific scope/import rules. Unlike build or source files, it is the maintainers’ narrative description of how gm2’s symbol tables, passes, dialects, and generated artifacts fit together, serving as the subsystem-level design documentation for the Modula-2 front end.
